tools.name: board_list
tools.description: Show the lemma board: every posted lemma with its statement, status (open, claimed, submitted, done, rejected, blocked), owner and notes.

tools.name: board_post
tools.description: Post a lemma to the board: its name and its full Lean statement (the declaration up to and excluding the proof). Names are unique across the board. By default you claim it as well.

name.description: The lemma's Lean name, as declared (for example core_card_le_three)

statement.description: The full declaration without proof, for example `private lemma foo (n : ℕ) (h : 0 < n) : 1 ≤ n`

claim.description: Claim the lemma for yourself (default true)

tools.name: board_claim
tools.description: Claim an open (or blocked, or rejected-by-someone-else) lemma so that you are the one proving it. A lemma has at most one owner at a time.

tools.name: board_done
tools.description: Submit a proof of a lemma you own: the complete Lean text of the declaration, statement and proof. It is compiled independently (against the original file and the already verified lemmas); if it compiles without sorry the lemma becomes done and is available to everyone, otherwise it is rejected with the compiler's message and you may resubmit.

proof.description: The full declaration with its proof, exactly as it would appear in the file

tools.name: board_blocked
tools.description: Give up a lemma you own and say in one sentence where it is stuck. The lemma becomes claimable by others.

tools.name: board_pull
tools.description: Copy a done lemma's verified source into your Problem.lean, immediately before the target theorem's docstring or attribute line, and return the source. Does nothing if the file already declares that name.
